title: Can social skills groups be a part of Speech Therapy for my child with Autism?
metaTitle: Social Skills Groups and Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network combines social skills groups with individual Speech Therapy to enhance your child's communication and social interaction skills.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that enabling your child to practice social and communication skills in a real-world, group setting can be highly beneficial. This supplement to individual Speech Therapy sessions allows for the application of skills learned in therapy to broader social interactions, an integral part of overall skill development and progression.
